title: Critic verdict
description: What one critic returns and what the review gate records. Every finding cites a rule id from .claude/context/rules.json — a finding without one is inadmissible, which is how 'no invented rules' becomes a validation error instead of an instruction.

verdict.description: pass = nothing found. revise = concerns worth answering, does not stop the gate. block = at least one violation; the gate refuses the merge or close.

notes.description: Optional context for the human. Never a substitute for a finding.

rule.description: A rule id from rules.json. Use UNENUMERATED for a real concern the registry does not cover yet — it can never block.

file.description: Repo-relative path the finding is in.

evidence.description: What is actually there, and why it breaks the rule. Not a restatement of the rule.

severity.description: Must not exceed the rule's severity_max.

suggested_rule.description: Required when rule is UNENUMERATED: the rule that should exist, and the document that would state it.
